simple.meaning: בָּשָׁן (Bâshân) appears 60 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, and 10 more, beginning at Numbers 21:33. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּשָׁן (H1316) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows בָּשָׁן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: בָּשָׁן (Bâshân) / H1316 is tracked through Numbers 21:33, Numbers 32:33, Deuteronomy 1:4, Deuteronomy 3:1. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: Bashan (often with the article), a region East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H1316. Bashan בָּשָׁן 60 proper name, of a territory, masculine Deut 3:3 ( smooth (& fertile) land) Bashan, first mentioned as kingdom of Og, east of Jordan, stretching from stream Jabbok (thus including northern Gilead) northward to Hermon, between Gennesaret (west) and mountains of Hauran (east); compare Di Num 21:33 Wetzst Hauran 82 ; later a type of fertility; — usually with article ׳הַבּ 21:33 (twice in verse); 32:33 ; Deut 1:4 30 t. Deuteronomy, Joshua; 1Kin 4:13 , 19 ; 2Kin 10:33 ; 1Chr 5:11-12 , 16 , 23 ; 6:47 ; 6:56 ; Neh 9:22 ; Psa 68:23 ; 135:11 ; 136:20 ; Jer 22:20 ; 50:19 (|| הַכַּרְמֶל ), Micah 7:14 (|| id. ), Nahum 1:4 (|| id. ; personified, subject of אֻמְלַל ), Isa 33:9 (|| id. ; personified subject of נֹעֵר ); הַרבָּֿשָׁן (i.e. range of Hauran) Psa 68:16 (twice in verse) (called הַראֿלהים , — from a sanctuary there? — & הַרגַּֿבְנֻנִּים many-peaked mountain ); of stately trees הַבּ ׳אַלּוֺנֵי Isa 2:13 (still seen on western slope of mountains of Hauran, Wetzst Hauran 88 ); ב ׳אַלּוֺנֵי Zech 11:2 (figurative of prominent men); מִבּ ׳אַלּוֺנִים Ezek 27:6 ; of bulls ב ׳אַבִּידֵי Psa 22:13 (|| מָּרִים figurative); so ׳בְּנֵיבֿ Deut 32:14 (+ וְאֵילִים כָּרִים also עַתּוּדִים , compare בָּקָר & צאֹן v a ; see בֵּן 1. j. ( ν )); apparently more General is ב ׳מְרִיאֵי Ezek 39:18 (reference to כֻּלָּם ֗֗֗ מָּרִים וְעַתּוּדִים כָּרִים אֵילִים ); once of kine (feminine, figurative of luxurious and haughty women of Samaria) Amos 4:1 הַבּ ׳מָּרוֺת .
